entries.german:
Grabstein des Johann Mönch von Rosenberg † 16. V. 1487 und des Eberhard Mönch von Rosenberg † 14. X. 1429.
Am Rande stand:
`Anno Domini MCCCCLXXXVII. die xvii Maji † Venerabilis Dominus Joannes Mönch de Rosenberg Mog. ac Worm. Ecclesiarum Canonicus et jubilarius, quorum animae &c.`
Die Ahnenwappen an den vier Ecken des Steines bezogen sich nur auf den Johannes Mönch.
Mönch von Rosenberg | Adelsheim
Kalb von Reinheim | .......
Abweichungen bei Helwich: Zu 2.) die XVI mensis — huius Ecclesiae canonicus et in spiritualibus vicarius, cuius anima requiescat in pace.
Bourdon Nr. 20. — Helwich, Annalen I f. 322, III f. 858. — Fragmenta Gamans f. 43 (bringt nur 1). — Gudenus II S. 903 Nr. 167. — Joannis II S. 234, 332, 383 zur Person.
entries.english:
Gravestone of Johann Mönch von Rosenberg, died 16 May 1487, and of Eberhard Mönch von Rosenberg, died 14 October 1429.
It read at the edge:
In the year of the Lord 1487, on the 17th day of May, † the venerable Lord Johannes Mönch von Rosenberg, canon of the churches of Mainz and Worms and jubilarius, whose souls etc.
The ancestral arms at the four corners of the stone referred only to Johannes Mönch.
Mönch von Rosenberg | Adelsheim
Kalb von Reinheim | .......
Variant in Helwich: on the 16th of the month — canon of this church and vicar in spiritual matters, may his soul rest in peace.
Bourdon no. 20. — Helwich, Annalen I f. 322, III f. 858. — Fragmenta Gamans f. 43 (gives only 1). — Gudenus II p. 903 no. 167. — Joannis II pp. 234, 332, 383 on the person.

facts.content: was canon of the churches of Mainz and Worms and jubilarius.
